policy: DB-level dev split only; final_eval is held out. mini_dev is an English-only hard slice; fast_dev and full_dev use broad DB coverage and prefer question_en with question_zh fallback.

mini_dev.role: Frequent low-cost agent evaluation on a hard English-only slice.

fast_dev.role: Intermediate evaluation with all 36 dev databases represented.

full_dev.role: Full checkpoint comparison and model selection evaluation.
